camera.motion: static (background identical across frames; the magnifier's rest pose is pixel-identical in frames 24-29 and all static props stay fixed)
camera.view: front view, slightly above table height, looking at a desk mat on a table in front of a teal wall; the mat recedes in perspective (back edge y~948, front edge strip y~1045-1060), but the falling motion is vertical in a plane facing the camera

objects.name: magnifier
objects.description: magnifying glass: round lens with silver/bluish rim, white ferrule, tan/brown wooden handle with dark tip pointing right; the ONLY moving object
objects.reference_point: bbox centre (ref_x/ref_y) and mask centroid both given; the Blender origin is not visible - for a rigid magnifier it is probably near the bbox centre or the lens centre. The motion is a vertical drop, so vertical displacements are the same for any point while the object does not rotate (frames 0-11).

extents_in_flight_px.note: frames 0-10 the lens is nearly edge-on (slightly tilted, apparent height 42 px at f0 shrinking to 20 px at f7 then 40 px at f10/11 as it rotates slowly); horizontal length stays 161-162 px throughout the fall

extents_at_rest_px_frame29.note: lying flat on the mat, handle pointing right and toward the camera (foreshortened), so the horizontal extent (151) is less than the true length (162 in flight); bottom edge from mask clipped at y=1046 because of reflections on the mat front strip

objects.name: typewriter
objects.description: vintage black/cream typewriter on the left of the mat, keys facing camera
objects.reliability: edges read off zoomed frames, +/-5 px

objects.name: card_with_scissors_and_stamp
objects.description: small cream paper card lying on the mat right of centre, with a dark pair of scissors / metal tool lying on it and a dark brown block (stamp/ink pad) at its right end

objects.name: desk_mat
objects.description: large dark green/brown leather desk mat with printed border, on a table; the ground surface the magnifier lands on
objects.note: extends past left/right/bottom image borders at the front; perspective trapezoid

objects.name: wall
objects.description: plain teal backdrop, upper ~88% of the image

events.note: first frame-to-frame drop is ~half of the later per-frame increment, i.e. starts from rest at frame 0
contact happens between frames 11 and 12 (~frame 11.2, t~0.467 s by extrapolating the bottom edge to the rest level y~1046)

events.event: bounce: magnifier pivots on left rim, handle flips up
